browse_records.description: Read every record in an index, or every record matching a query and filters, up to 1,000 at a time. Give the next cursor back to read the next batch, until has more is false. Unlike a search, a browse is not limited to the first 1,000 results. The API key needs the browse permission.

parameters.description: Algolia filter syntax, like category:shoes AND price < 100, or (brand:Acme OR brand:Zenith) AND NOT discontinued:true. A text attribute must be listed in the index's attributes for faceting to be filtered on; a filter on one that isn't is reported rather than matching nothing.

parameters.description: A name for this kind of event, up to 64 characters, like Product Purchased.
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.description: The index the records belong to.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: Who did it: a user ID or an anonymous visitor ID, using only letters, digits and = + / _ -. Never an email address or other personal data.
parameters.name: user_token

parameters.description: The object IDs of the records concerned, up to 20.
parameters.name: object_ids

parameters.description: For a click or conversion after a search, the queryID that search returned, so Algolia credits it. Leave empty otherwise.
parameters.name: query_id

parameters.description: For a click with a search query ID: where each record appeared in the results, 1 for the first, one per object ID.
parameters.name: positions

parameters.description: For an add to cart or a purchase, its total value, like 59.99.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: The value's currency, as a three-letter code like USD.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Where the application keeps its analytics and events, shown under Settings > Application in the Algolia dashboard. Most applications use the United States.
parameters.name: region

set_settings.description: Change some of an index's settings and keep the others, using Algolia's names, like {"attributesForFaceting": ["brand", "searchable(category)"]} or {"customRanking": ["desc(popularity)"]}.
set_settings.display_str_template: Update the settings of the Algolia index '{0}'.
set_settings.name: set_settings

parameters.description: The index to write to. Algolia creates it on the first write if it doesn't exist.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: The settings to change, under Algolia's names: searchableAttributes, attributesForFaceting, customRanking, hitsPerPage and the rest. Settings left out stay as they are.
parameters.name: settings

parameters.description: Also make the change on the index's replicas (its copies sorted another way). Off by default, as in Algolia.
parameters.name: forward_to_replicas

task_id.description: Algolia applies the change in the background; give this to Wait for a task to wait until it is searchable. 0 when nothing was sent.

wait_for_task.description: Wait until Algolia has applied a change, so the steps after it see it. Algolia applies writes in the background, usually within a few seconds. Give it the task ID (or the whole result) of the step that made the change.
wait_for_task.name: wait_for_task

parameters.description: The index the change was made to. For a copy or move, the index copied or moved.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: The task ID the change's step returned, or that step's whole result. 0 (a step that changed nothing) returns at once.
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.description: How long to wait before failing the step, from 1 to 300 seconds (default 60).
parameters.name: max_wait_seconds

status.description: published once the change is applied

description: Search, browse and filter the records in your Algolia indices; add, update and delete records one at a time or thousands at once; manage index settings, synonyms and merchandising rules; copy, move and delete indices; read Search Analytics; send view, click and purchase events; and get Recommend suggestions.
